name: tests-half-alt-dhcp-strict-dhcpv4-semantic-validation
instr:
Add opt-in DHCPv4 semantic validation. Preserve existing behavior.

These are required in what you deliver:

- `github.com/insomniacslk/dhcp/dhcpv4`: `ValidationPolicy` with `WarningsAsErrors`; `DefaultValidationPolicy()`; `ValidationIssue` with Path, Code, Severity, Message; `ValidationErrorSeverity`; `OptionValueValidator`; `ValidationError` implementing error with `Issues []ValidationIssue`.
- `OptionsFromList(...Option) Options`; `Options.Validate(policy ValidationPolicy) []ValidationIssue`; `(*DHCPv4).Validate(policy ValidationPolicy) []ValidationIssue`.
- `FromBytesWithValidation(data []byte, policy ValidationPolicy) (*DHCPv4, error)`.
- `ApplyValidated(packet *DHCPv4, policy ValidationPolicy, modifiers ...Modifier) error`.
- `server4.WithValidation(policy dhcpv4.ValidationPolicy)`, composable with WithConn.
- `client4.(*Client).ExchangeValidated(ifname string, policy dhcpv4.ValidationPolicy, modifiers ...dhcpv4.Modifier) ([]*dhcpv4.DHCPv4, error)`.
- `netboot.RequestNetbootv4Validated(ifname string, timeout time.Duration, retries int, policy dhcpv4.ValidationPolicy, modifiers ...dhcpv4.Modifier) ([]*dhcpv4.DHCPv4, error)`.

Default validation accepts assigned AutoConfiguration values, canonical IPv4 scalar/list values, whole-second lease durations, requested-option lists preserving order, and message size 576. Diagnose AutoConfiguration 2 even with WarningsAsErrors, nil requested IP, empty router list, message size 575, duration exceeding MaxLeaseTime, and Duration und
